raw_extraction.description: Waterfall.io is a B2B data solution that aggregates 30+ data vendors to provide verified emails, phone numbers, contact enrichment, job change tracking, and contact search with a unified data schema and high uptime. It offers a modular and scalable GTM API for building reliable data pipelines with real-time verified contact data globally, usage-based pricing, and enterprise-grade security and compliance.
raw_extraction.api_breadth: Provides APIs for prospector, contact enrichment, phone enrichment, and job changes with unified data schema and high rate limits.
raw_extraction.buildability_rationale: The API is documented with example curl, Python, and Node.js requests using an API key for authentication. The API supports multiple endpoints for prospector, contact enrichment, phone enrichment, and job changes, with high rate limits and 99.99% uptime. Direct developer support is available via Slack for onboarding and implementation help.
